source_name: Registrų centras JAR — Register of Legal Entities (JuridinisAsmuo)
organization: Registrų centras (Centre of Registers) via data.gov.lt

fields.meaning: Company code (įmonės kodas / juridinio asmens kodas), 9-digit. Company id, legal-entity taxpayer code, and universal join key.
fields.limitations: Returned as an integer; store as string to preserve any leading characters in joins.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary business key across all JAR models.

example_values: Bendra Lietuvos - Jungtinių Amerikos Valstijų įmonė uždaroji akcinė bendrovė "STT Inc."
fields.limitations: Embeds the legal-form phrase (e.g. uždaroji akcinė bendrovė).
Often null on this model; addresses are in the Buveine model.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was deregistered (null if active).
fields.analysis_notes: Presence implies the entity is removed/deregistered.

fields.meaning: Reference to the legal-form code (Forma model).
fields.code_list: datasets/gov/rc/jar/formos_statusai/Forma (168 forms; kodas + LT pavadinimas + EN name)
fields.limitations: A UUID reference; resolve against Forma.
fields.analysis_notes: Join forma._id -> Forma._id to get kodas/name.

fields.meaning: Reference to the legal-status code (Statusas model).
fields.code_list: datasets/gov/rc/jar/formos_statusai/Statusas (31 statuses; 0 not registered..6 bankrupt..10 removed..11 liquidated)
fields.limitations: A UUID reference; resolve against Statusas.
fields.analysis_notes: Join statusas._id -> Statusas._id to get kodas/pavadinimas/name.

fields.meaning: Date the current legal status took effect.
